description: Per-repository settings of the GitLab review bot, read from the MR's target branch. Generated from internal/config (UPDATE_SCHEMA=1 go test ./internal/config -run TestRepoSchemaUpToDate); reference: docs/configuration.md.

auto_review.description: AutoReview=false: no automatic reviews; commands still work.

big_mr.description: BigMR: block=true makes a too-big MR merge-blocking here.

block.description: Block=true makes a too-big MR merge-blocking in this repository (false does not turn the service setting off).

ci.description: CI: enabled=false turns the CI failure digest off for this repository; ignore_jobs adds job globs (see ci.go).

enabled.description: Enabled=false: no digest, no explanation, no main branch notes for this repository (it cannot turn the feature on).

ignore_jobs.description: IgnoreJobs: job name globs (path.Match, e.g. "deploy-*") whose failures are not analysed, added to review.ci.ignore_jobs.

enabled.description: Enabled=false turns the check off for the repository (default true).

openapi.description: OpenAPI, Proto and GraphQL are extra path globs (doublestar syntax) of spec files, on top of the built-in discovery.

context.description: Context controls context repositories for this repo (see context.go).

enabled.description: Enabled=false gives this repository's reviews no context repositories.

exclude.description: Exclude are doublestar globs of project paths ("legacy/**", "group/huge-monorepo"), matched case-insensitively.

related.description: Related are repositories this one works with (its frontend, clients, the services it calls). They are always given to Claude first, beyond review.context.max_repos and regardless of Exclude, may lie outside gitlab.groups (the bot account needs read access), and the prompt marks them with the note.

note.description: Note says how the repositories are related ("фронтенд, вызывает наш REST API из src/api").

repo.description: Repo is the full project path, e.g. "frontend/web".

coverage.description: Coverage: which CI job artifact holds the coverage report.

min.description: Min is the warning threshold in percent of covered changed lines (0 = no warning). Never blocks the merge.

description_summary.description: DescriptionSummary=false keeps the bot out of this repo's MR descriptions (it cannot turn review.description_summary on).

diagram.description: Diagram=false drops the Mermaid diagram from this repo's summaries.

enabled.description: Enabled=false turns the bot off for the repo (commands still answer).

ignore.description: Ignore: doublestar globs of files not reviewed (added to the service review.default_ignore).

instructions.description: Instructions: free text for the reviewer about this repository.

project_keys.description: ProjectKeys replaces jira.project_keys of the service for this repo, e.g. ["PROJ"]. Empty keeps the service value.

title_prompt.description: TitlePrompt / TitleLanguage replace jira.title_prompt / jira.title_language of the service for this repository (empty = the service value).

labels.description: Labels: automatic MR labels for this repository (see labels.go).

enabled.description: Enabled=false turns labels off for the repository (it cannot turn them on when the service switch is off).
Enabled=false removes a service rule of the same name in a repository (default true).

instruction.description: Instruction: when the label applies, in words; the review model decides.

paths.description: Paths: doublestar globs; the label applies when any file changed by the MR matches one of them.

when_fact.description: WhenFact: deterministic facts the bot computes itself (LabelFacts); one name or a list, any of them matches.

language.description: Language of the review ("ru", "en"); default review.default_language.

learn.description: Learn: enabled=false neither learns from this repo's threads nor applies learned rules in its reviews.

limits.description: Limits can only make the service limits stricter.

lint.description: Lint: linters and scanners for this repo (see lint.go).

ci.description: CI are the linter reports of the repository's own CI jobs, read from the MR head pipeline.

artifact.description: Artifact is the report's path inside the job artifacts archive.

blocking.description: Blocking: results follow review.block_min_severity instead of never blocking the merge.

job.description: Job is the job name; a glob (path.Match: *, ?, [..]) is allowed. Parallel instances ("phpstan 1/2") match the plain name.

report.description: Report: "codequality" reads the job's GitLab Code Quality report (artifacts:reports:codequality) instead of an artifact path.

severity.description: Severity for every result; empty = from the report.

tool.description: Tool is the shown name (ci:<tool>); default: the job name.

disable.description: Disable lists tools not to run for this repository (gitleaks).

enabled.description: Enabled=false turns off everything except gitleaks (which stays on unless review.lint.allow_disable_secrets), CI linters included.

max_files.description: MaxFiles: at most this many files are reviewed (default 200).

max_mr_lines.description: MaxMRLines: a stricter (lower) review.max_mr_lines for this repository; 0 = the service value (see bigmr.go).

mcp.description: MCP: enabled=false turns the review tools of the MCP server off for this repository (it cannot turn them on).

memory.description: Memory: enabled=false neither reads nor writes the project memory.

migrations.description: Migrations: the migration safety check for this repo (see migrations.go).

dialect.description: Dialect replaces review.migrations.dialect for the repository.

enabled.description: Enabled=false turns the check off for the repository.

paths.description: Paths and Exclude are added to the service globs.

path_instructions.description: PathInstructions: extra instructions for files matching a glob (see paths.go).

problems.description: Problems: summary=false hides the "could not check" block (and its mentions) in this repository's summaries (see problems.go).

reactions.description: Reactions: enabled=false turns the bot's award emoji off for this repository (it cannot turn them on or change them; see reactions.go).

skills.description: Skills: which team skills this repo's reviews get (see skills.go).

disable.description: Disable lists skill names not offered in this repository.

enabled.description: Enabled=false offers no skills in this repository's reviews.

sysmap.description: Sysmap: files of this repository the system map never scans.

exclude.description: Exclude are doublestar globs of files in this repository that are never scanned ("legacy/**", "src/mocks/**").

tbd.description: TBD: thresholds of the trunk-based status block (see tbd.go).

feature_flags.description: FeatureFlags=false turns the feature-flag rule off for this repo.

flags_hint.description: FlagsHint replaces review.tbd.flags_hint for this repo.

todo.description: Todo: the TODO-without-task check for this repo (see todo.go).

blocking.description: Blocking=true makes the results blocking (cannot relax the service).

enabled.description: Enabled=false turns the check off for the repository.

ignore.description: Ignore globs are added to review.todo.ignore.

verify.description: Verify: enabled=false turns the verification of findings off for this repository (it cannot turn it on; see verify.go).

title: .reviewbot.yaml
